verdict.rationale: Google Cloud's official free page documents both parts of the story: new customers get $300 in free credit and are not charged until they activate a paid account, and an always-free tier covers AI APIs, Compute Engine, BigQuery and other products up to monthly limits, separate from the credit. The evidence states that limits exist but does not quote any of them, and it gives no credit expiry window. missing for 10: stated expiry period for the $300 credit, concrete per-product free-tier limits, a published startup credits program, independent corroboration.
